verdict.rationale: Granola's own site says it works with Zoom, Google Meet and Teams by capturing computer audio without a bot. Its docs say it detects when a call ends and starts transcribing from a calendar notification, and it posts a chat message when transcription begins. The 'recording where I want it' part is thin: the evidence only shows transcription and screenshots of shared screens, with no documented audio or video recording or per-meeting recording controls, and nothing independent backs the reliability claim. Missing for 10: audio/video recording retention and control, per-platform capture detail, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable capture across Zoom, Meet and Teams.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.
Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot
Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing
Once Granola has recognised your call has ended, or you stop it manually, it will automatically generate enhanced notes.
